highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with corrected image filtering, glyph rasterization and GPU geometry.
highlights_body: The stable release adds texture-subset and image-filter cache corrections plus safer mask-filtered glyph handling. Earlier previews supplied path, clip, text-atlas and Vulkan fixes. Managed APIs remain unchanged, and HarfBuzzSharp retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

breaking.title: Check Graphite Metal deployment targets
breaking.body: Graphite Metal adopts an iOS/tvOS 15 runtime minimum; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise lower application deployment targets before using this backend, retaining any higher requirement from the managed target or framework.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 accompanies this milestone while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

bullets.lead: Filtered images stay within their source subsets
bullets.detail: Prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from appearing under minification, strong skew, antialiased clipping or MSAA. Image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash, including matrix metadata and signed-zero representations.

bullets.lead: Mask-filtered glyphs use their regenerated layout
bullets.detail: Rasterizes the reloaded glyph rather than a stale outline, rejects incompatible mask formats before copying, and preserves full plane strides for clipped embossed glyphs. Incompatible or non-overlapping masks produce cleared output instead of invalid copies or format assertions.

bullets.lead: Corrected GPU geometry, clipping and text replay
bullets.detail: Fixes transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles, reflected hairline caps, glyph-atlas selection and stale atlas work after empty flushes. Also corrects convex-path rasterization, glyph replay validation, Graphite clip recording and alpha-to-RGBx readback.

bullets.lead: More precise displacement and Vulkan synchronization
bullets.detail: Displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds. Native synchronous Vulkan submission accounts for fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit remains void. A targeted device-loss cleanup delay applies to affected ARM proprietary driver versions 42 through below 56, not ordinary successful submissions.
LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select the native cdecl convention, matching existing DllImport paths and avoiding an ABI mismatch on Windows x86. Public managed signatures are unchanged.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m157 with corrected path rasterization, glyph replay and Graphite readback. LibraryImport declarations gained explicit cdecl metadata, while HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.200 without a native engine upgrade.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrected reflected hairline square caps and text-atlas selection. It also added a device-loss cleanup delay limited to affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19: Release Candidate 2 corrected transformed GPU geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip capacity. Displacement offsets gained fp32 precision, and native synchronous Vulkan submission began accounting for fence-wait failures without changing the void GRContext.Submit API.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 keeps native HarfBuzz at 14.4.0 and has no public API diff. Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing native calling convention.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 brings Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, in addition to any higher framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.

v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.headline: Release Candidate 2 improves transformed GPU geometry, Graphite clipping and displacement-filter precision.
v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.body: It also corrects stale Ganesh atlas work and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling. GRContext.Submit remains void; no managed failure-reporting result is added.

v4.157.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 corrects filtered image subsets and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
v4.157.0.body: The stable cut prevents backing-texture pixels leaking into filtered images, aligns image-filter cache equality with hashing, and handles regenerated glyph formats and clipped mask planes correctly. These changes do not alter managed APIs.
